subject.title: fix(cli): oversized secrets plans consume unbounded memory

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a 16 MiB hard ceiling for existing and externally generated secrets plan files in both `secrets configure --plan-out` and `secrets apply --from`?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent, but the numeric ceiling changes an existing public CLI workflow for unusually large valid plans and is not derivable from a purely mechanical correctness check.

options.title: Adopt the 16 MiB contract
options.body: Accept the documented ceiling and merge the shared configure/apply enforcement with its boundary coverage.

options.title: Choose a different compatibility boundary
options.body: Revise the public ceiling or output behavior before merge if existing large-plan workflows need a different supported path.

recommendation.title: Adopt the 16 MiB contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented ceiling and merge the shared configure/apply enforcement with its boundary coverage.
